facts.fact: NBR says eKash, the national instant payment system, was launched nationwide on 14 July 2026 and processed over 10.5 million transactions worth over FRW 960 billion.
NBR describes eKash as an interoperable instant payment system used through banks and mobile money providers, with interoperable service users rising from 740,787 to 1,971,522.
NBR calls eKash Rwanda's national instant payment system, reached through banks and mobile money providers, launched nationwide on 14 July 2026.
